Description: "Root cause fix: z-index:-2 placed the parallax layer behind the body's solid background-color, making it permanently invisible. Restructured z-index stack: bg image (0) → particles (1) → content (10)."
Instruction: "Fix z-index layering: parallax-bg-layer should be z-index:0 (above body background), canvas-container z-index:1 (particles above bg image), and content container z-index:10 (stays same). This ensures the background image is visible above body's dark color."
